notes: Morning part of the Monday plenary (session monday-plenary), University of Oslo Aula, about 1h36m. Covers the opening, local welcome (Hugo de Boer), housekeeping, the TDWG Chair's address (David Bloom) and the first keynote (Tanya Berger-Wolf) with Q&A, ending at the coffee break (restart announced for 11:05). The programme ran about 30 minutes behind schedule. ASR regularly renders TDWG as 'TADWIG'/'TIDWEG'/'ADWIC' and Imageomics as 'Image Genomics'.

Monday plenary (monday-plenary), late-morning block between the coffee break and lunch: two keynote talks (Heatta, event-006; Walls, event-007). This is not the afternoon session; the chair's closing remarks refer to the afternoon 'Taste of TDWG' session. Timestamps are relative to the start of this file (HH:MM:SS).

Monday afternoon 'Taste of TDWG' block of the Monday plenary (session monday-plenary), University of Oslo Aula, about 2h10m. Opens with announcements from the TDWG chair, then convener Ellie Wallace introduces eight speakers in seven 15-minute talks (event-010 to event-017), all given in programme order. Ends with a BISS extended-abstract plug and directions to the City Hall reception with the mayor. The morning items (event-003, 004, 006, 007) are in Aula_Plenary_1 and Aula_Plenary_2. ASR often renders TDWG as 'TADWIG'.

Continuous full-day recording of ODIN (00:00 ≈ 8:30 AM) covering four sessions: SYM18 'Building resilient data infrastructures for biodiversity science' (00:00:18-02:01:25), SYM11 'Data Quality: From Standard to Practice' (02:28:23-03:59:17), CO3 'Semantic Interoperability and Standards Infrastructure' (05:29:27-06:46:37) and LT16 'Community-Powered, Research-Ready: Citizen Science for a Digital Future' (07:29:30-08:14:26), with breaks in between. All programmed talks were given except the cancelled event-155; the LT16 discussion slot was not used. Event-124 (no programmed speaker) was presented by Lars Vogt under a new title. The start of SYM23 had no sound (as the programme notes): the transcript has almost nothing between 00:08:31 and 00:17:29, so Dimitri Brosens' talk is only partially captured and Will Morris' talk is captured from part-way through. In LT17 Andrew Jones' pre-recorded talk was played late (after Arianna Salili-James), and Nicole Fisher's virtual talk was attempted twice and skipped because its audio was inaudible.
